summary: A mangrove forest reserve on the coast of Ho Chi Minh City, explored by boat along shaded creeks. Visit the Rung Sac wartime base and the salt pans, then pick live seafood at the Hang Duong market by the town beach. A good day trip, or one night, for nature lovers staying in the city.

seoTitle: Can Gio travel guide — mangrove creeks and monkey island
seoDescription: A mangrove creek at Vàm Sát, long-tailed macaques on monkey island, then Hàng Dương beside the sand. The road is about 1 hour 30 minutes or about 2 hours, then the Bình Khánh ferry.
intro: You sit in a boat on a mangrove creek at Vàm Sát, dark water in front and trunks through the middle, with long-tailed macaques on the bank at monkey island. You sleep in the beach town, xã Cần Giờ, or in a room at the forest centre. Ho Chi Minh City is the other night, when the city is the trip and this reserve is the day.

Leave early. On 30 April 2026 a holiday queue on Huỳnh Tấn Phát ran nearly two hours, and one traveler counted nearly three hours including the wait. On the water the crossing is about 10–15 minutes, about 1.2 km on the Soài Rạp. After the ferry, đường Rừng Sác is about 30 km of trees. The Sac Forest gate is 7:30–17:30. Vàm Sát’s gate is 8:00–17:00 every day. They are different desks.

The evening is chợ hải sản Hàng Dương on đường Thạnh Thới, beside bãi 30 tháng 4. The sand is about 50 m from the market. You point at a live animal and the stall cooks it, or you take a pan already on the fire. If you are still in town in the morning, Lăng Ông Thủy Tướng is the whale temple.
gettingAround: The forest is about 1 hour 30 minutes and about 50 km from the city centre, via Nguyễn Văn Linh, a right onto Huỳnh Tấn Phát, and phà Bình Khánh at the end of that road. The same trip is also about 2 hours. A market account also gives about 50 km. For the Cần Thạnh salt village the distance is about 30 km, about 60 km in the same account, and about 30 km south from the old district centre.

From 18 March 2026 the ferry charges 3,000 VND to walk or cycle, 8,000 VND for a motorbike, and 11,000 VND for a motorbike with a passenger. Cars under 30 seats rose about 1,000–2,000 VND. From 5 May 2025 a walk or bicycle was 2,000 VND, a motorbike 7,000 VND, and a car under 7 seats 40,000 VND. That earlier notice does not replace the March 2026 walk and motorbike fares. The ferry was still the crossing on 13 September 2026.

On 30 April 2026 the bridge was given as about 6.3 km, six lanes, and an investment of more than 13,200 billion VND, with groundbreaking in January 2026. On 13 September 2026 the whole line was about 7.3 km in the lead and about 7 km later, with a bridge portion of about 3 km, and component 2 at about 10,668 billion VND including interest during construction. The two sums may be different slices of the project. A planned start on 25 August 2026 and a BT contract on 20 September 2026 had not been met when that September account ran. A future high-speed line from Bến Thành to Cần Giờ is named there.

From 1 August 2025 the subsidized list includes MST 90 from Phà Bình Khánh to Cần Thạnh, MST 77 from Đồng Hòa to Cần Thạnh, and MST 128 from Tân Điền to An Nghĩa. Free rides cover children at or under 1.3 m, war wounded and sick soldiers, disabled riders, people 70 and over, and holders of a free-bus card. Route 20 still runs to the ferry and then route 90, or route 75 direct from Công viên 23/9. Routes 20 and 75 are not on the August 2025 list. In 2019 route 75 was 20,000 VND. A 2019 hydrofoil from Bến Bạch Đằng to biển Cần Thạnh was an adult one-way fare of 200,000 VND.

Sleep in xã Cần Giờ, or in the rooms at the forest centre. Vàm Sát boats leave from cầu Dần Xây. The management board is at 1541 đường Rừng Sác. A motorbike is the way along the forest road. The bird add-on at Vàm Sát is sold from May through October. Tràm Chim breeding runs from April through October.

stayAreas.summary: Family rooms and dorms at the forest centre, with breakfast included on the family room. No hotel brand.

eat: Hàng Dương, on đường Thạnh Thới, is the seafood market beside bãi 30 tháng 4. You choose a live animal and the stall cooks it, or you take a pan already on the fire. The sand is about 50 m away. One seller in 2019 sold from about 7:00 until about 21:00. Cook fees that year were 10,000 VND a kilogram for steaming and 30,000 for the other cooks, and a later account puts cook-to-order at a few tens of thousands of đồng.

Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất are the sit-down streets in the old town centre, now xã Cần Giờ. On 2 October 2022 the plates named there were lẩu cá dứa, cá dứa kho, tôm tích, ốc len, sò huyết, vọp, hàu nướng, and cá đuối hấp. On 28 April 2024 the mudskipper salad, ba khía with lá buôi, salt-crusted mullet, straw-grilled duck, and rượu mật ong rừng Sác were named with the salad. Salt is what people carry home from the pans.

interestsBody: Lẩu cá dứa in the town, and Hàng Dương beside the sand.

The picture is the creek at Vàm Sát, and the macaques on monkey island. The evening is the market and the black sand. The whale temple is the pin for lunar month 8, and a short visit on an ordinary morning.
Salt is a December–May morning on the pans. The rooms at Vàm Sát are a forest overnight. Hàng Dương and the salt you carry are the shopping.

interestGroups.title: The mangrove
interestGroups.summary: For a dry morning on the water, when the creek is the reason you came.
body: This is the mangrove biosphere, called the city’s green lung. Recognition is 21 January 2000, and the nomination year is 2000, Vietnam’s first. Habitats are mangroves, wetlands, salt marshes, mudflats, and seagrasses. The soil is river silt from the Sài Gòn and Đồng Nai, plus a brackish water table. People live in the transition zone. The core and the buffer are forest-guard households, staff, and a few traditional shrimp traps.

The area is 75,740 ha with a population of 71,157; 70,445.34 ha and more than 75,000 people in 2018; more than 75,000 hectares, with a core of 4,721 ha, a buffer of 41,139 ha, and a transition of 29,880 ha; and a core of 6,134.43 ha, a buffer of 29,152.10 ha of forest land and 12,763.56 ha of water, and a transition of 13,227.79 ha of forest land and 7,267.47 ha of water. A 2012 evaluation said 71,964 ha and 67,272 people in November 2011.

Vàm Sát is the forest centre. The tariff still says xã Lý Nhơn. From 1 July 2025 that commune sits inside xã An Thới Đông. The road gate is 60,000 VND, shuttle included, under 6 free, ages 6–11 half, over 11 adult, open 8:00–17:00 every day. From cầu Dần Xây the canoe is 1,075,000 VND for one person, 650,000 for two, 440,000 for three, 320,000 for four to seven, 300,000 for eight to eighteen, and 270,000 from nineteen. The same canoe leg is also from 270,000 VND to 895,000 VND. A full water package runs from 1,335,000 VND for one canoe down to 550,000 from nineteen. The wooden boat on that package is 445,000 from nineteen. A package without Tràm Chim is lower, from 1,260,000 for one canoe to 370,000 for a wooden boat from nineteen. A full-service band is 550,000–1,175,000. The 1,335,000 top and the 1,175,000 top are different. Add-ons include a crocodile swamp shuttle at 20,000 VND, a caged crocodile boat at 60,000, a bird reserve at 55,000 from May through October, a rowing boat at Đầm Dơi at 65,000, and a canoe to Đầm Dơi at 185,000.

A family room for two is 400,000 VND for a weekday day and 600,000 for a weekday night. A weekend day is 500,000 and a weekend night is 750,000, with breakfast included. A third person is an extra 200,000 on a weekday or 250,000 on a weekend. A dorm bed is 150,000 for a weekday day and 200,000 for a weekday night. A weekend day is 200,000 and a weekend night is 250,000.

Long-tailed macaques are more than 1,000, and also over 2,000 monkeys. Monkey Island is a separate entrance of 35,000 VND a person. That line and the 60,000 road gate are different desks. About 2,000 birds of 33 species are at Sân Chim Vàm Sát, and more than 500 bats at Đầm Dơi. Tràm Chim is also over 30 bird species and about 20,000 birds.

cards.title: Vàm Sát
cards.summary: The forest centre and monkey island. Road gate 60,000 VND with the shuttle, open 8:00–17:00 every day.

interestGroups.title: The Rừng Sác base
interestGroups.summary: For the rebuilt special-forces camp in this mangrove, once you are on the forest road.
body: You walk or take a canoe into the rebuilt camp. Observation posts, a military workshop, an information house, hideouts, a medical station, a supply house, and figures of Unit 10, including the raid on the Nhà Bè oil depot, are on the ground. The national historic listing is 2004. The region was used in the wars against France and the United States. Defoliant was sprayed many times from 1964 to 1972, and more than 80% of the old mangrove died.

Resolution 09/2020/NQ-HĐND, effective 1 January 2021, sets an adult fee of 35,000 VND a visit, domestic and foreign. Free: older people, disabled people, the armed forces, people with revolutionary merit, the veterans’ association, poor households, and children under 7. Half price: children from 7 to under 16, pupils, and students. Collection is assigned to the Củ Chi tunnels historic site. The same 35,000 VND is also given for the combat zone. A canoe is 600,000 VND a turn, round trip. The fee resolution does not mention a canoe.

The Sac Forest gate is 7:30–17:30. That is not Vàm Sát’s 8:00–17:00. Nearly 400 battles and 860 dead are named, and also thousands of large and small battles. Unit 10 and the years 1966 to 30 April 1975 are the history. The old address is đường Rừng Sác in xã Long Hòa, now part of xã Cần Giờ.

cards.title: Rừng Sác base
cards.summary: The rebuilt camp on the forest road. Adult 35,000 VND. The gate is 7:30–17:30.

interestGroups.title: The town beach
interestGroups.summary: For the late afternoon, when the market is cooking and the sand is a short walk.
body: Bãi 30 tháng 4 sits beside Hàng Dương, in the old xã Long Hòa, now xã Cần Giờ. The beach is still rough and about 50 m from the market, and people sit on the shore after eating. The Cần Giờ sand is black from silt.
Go late, when the market is cooking.

cards.title: 30 April beach
cards.summary: Black sand about 50 m from Hàng Dương.

interestGroups.title: Salt pans
interestGroups.summary: For a dry-season morning, December to May, if the raking is the reason you came.
body: The pans are along đường Duyên Hải in the old town, in the fields at Lý Nhơn, now inside xã An Thới Đông, and on đảo Thiềng Liềng in xã Thạnh An. On 10 March 2024 the area was about 1,500 ha at those three places, with crystals in 7–10 days of hard sun. On 14 January 2020 about 1,200 ha were in production, more than 1,000 ha on tarpaulin, a yield of 80 tons a hectare, and 7–9 days from the first crystal to harvest. The season is December–May. Most pans now crystallize on tarpaulin. The city recognized the Cần Thạnh village as a traditional craft village.

Go after sunrise on a hard sunny day. The picture is at dawn, and the heavy part of the job is the noon rake. Thạnh An is the island commune the 2025 resolution did not rearrange. Salt is what people carry home.

cards.title: The salt morning
cards.summary: December to May, after sunrise. About 1,500 ha, and about 1,200 ha in production.

interestGroups.title: Shopping
interestGroups.summary: Hàng Dương for the seafood you point at, and salt from the pans.

blocks.heading: Hàng Dương
paragraphs: Chợ hải sản Hàng Dương is on đường Thạnh Thới, beside bãi 30 tháng 4, about 50 m from the sand. You choose sò, ốc, cua, ghẹ, tôm, or mực and the stall cooks it, or you take a pan already on the fire. Steaming is 10,000 VND a kilogram, and rang muối, cháy tỏi, xào dừa, xào bơ, xào me, nướng mỡ hành, nướng phô mai, and nướng mọi are 30,000. Cook-to-order is also a few tens of thousands of đồng, and hấp xả lá chanh is among the cooks. A busy day can mean a wait of about 30–40 minutes. One seller sold from about 7:00 until about 21:00.

blocks.heading: Salt from the pans
paragraphs: Salt is the thing people carry home from the December–May pans along đường Duyên Hải, at Lý Nhơn, and on đảo Thiềng Liềng. About 1,500 ha, and about 1,200 ha in production.

faqs.q: How long is the ride from Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: About 1 hour 30 minutes and about 50 km to the forest, via Nguyễn Văn Linh and Huỳnh Tấn Phát to the Bình Khánh ferry, and also about 2 hours. On the water the ferry is about 10–15 minutes. On 30 April 2026 a holiday queue on Huỳnh Tấn Phát ran nearly 2 hours, and one traveler counted nearly 3 hours including the wait.

faqs.q: Is there one ticket for the reserve?
faqs.a: No. Vàm Sát’s road gate is 60,000 VND, shuttle included. Monkey Island is a separate 35,000 VND entrance. The Rừng Sác relic is 35,000 VND for an adult. The Sac Forest gate is 7:30–17:30 and Vàm Sát is 8:00–17:00.

faqs.q: Can you drive the new bridge?
faqs.a: The ferry was still the crossing on 13 September 2026. The line is about 7.3 km, and also about 7 km, with a bridge portion of about 3 km. A 30 April 2026 account gives about 6.3 km.

The festival sits on the 15th through the 17th of lunar month 8, with the sea rite at 10:00 on the 16th. In 2025 it was 5–7 October, lunar 14–16, and the sea rite at 9:00 on 7 October. In 2026 it was 23–27 September, with the procession on 26 September. The sea rite is given at 9:00 and at 10:00. The palanquin leaves Lăng Ông Thủy Tướng.

season.label: Dry mornings on the creek
season.note: Skip a storm day. Salt work is December–May. The Vàm Sát bird add-on is May through October, and Tràm Chim breeding runs from April through October. Nghinh Ông sits in lunar month 8: the 15th–17th with the sea rite at 10:00 on the 16th, lunar 14–16 in 2025 with the rite at 9:00, and 23–27 September 2026 with the procession on 26 September. A holiday can jam the Bình Khánh ferry. The bridge is not open.
